target_customer: Institutional commercial real estate investment teams, developers and brokers, with a focus on self-storage
problem: CRE teams spend analyst hours extracting deal package data into Excel models and screening sites by hand.
product_category: AI underwriting and site selection software for commercial real estate

founders.name: Jean-Michael Diei
education: Carnegie Mellon University, machine learning and computer vision
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led applied ML efforts at Microsoft.

founders.name: Matthew Krager
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as a long-time iOS and full-stack developer working in proptech; education not listed. CEO and CTO titles come from a YesPress profile seen in search.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document extraction with cell level citations and a trade area dataset are standard applied ML plus data engineering, with hard parts in messy OMs and rent rolls.

defensibility.rationale: Extraction and site data can be rebuilt by other vendors; stickiness depends on workflow embedding in underwriting models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying or buying the company; the search surfaced many CRE extraction vendors but without launch dates.

market_need_then: The YC page says CRE workflows are Excel heavy and slow dealmaking; no dated 2023 source for spend or complaints was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident and data focused, stresses traceability and defensible data

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; the name is a Prop plus Rise compound and results mix it up with unrelated companies.

outcome_analysis: PropRise is active and has grown from a three person team on the YC page to claiming 50 plus customers including Public Storage and Bain Capital on its site. Primer reportedly launched in 2024-01 for self-storage deals and Beacon covers site selection. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found; funding is thinly documented so its financing progress is unknown.
notes: Round rests on a single database (CB Insights: $1.2M pre-seed, 2023-09-29). Conflicts: Caplight lists $1.45M with a pre-seed date of 2023-08-01 (Singularity Capital, MetaProp); another profile calls the round seed in late 2023. Not summed. The company site says backed by YC, General Catalyst and MetaProp without amounts. Cross-check search found no press or filing. Competition: no dated near-2023 competitor source found.
